title: Nook
summary: Vacation rentals with availability, booking requests and reviews.
description: Guests browse stays with photo carousels and request dates; hosts list stays, accept requests and track earnings. Rules refuse overlapping stays and reviews before a stay, and a daily workflow completes past bookings.
roles_summary: Guests sign up. Hosts list stays and accept requests.
highlights: Rules: no overlapping stays, reviews only after a stay
